newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: TAURAS BANK SHARE ISSUE STARTS MAY 15.
newsitem.headline: TAURAS BANK SHARE ISSUE STARTS MAY 15.

text.p: Lithuania's Tauro Bank said in an advertisement in Lietuvos rytas Monday that it will start the distribution of a 40 million litas share issue on May 15.
In the advertisement, the bank also said that present shareholders will not have priority rights to buy the new shares.
The bank will sell four million shares, at a face value of 10 litas each, the ad said.
The secutities commission registered the new share issue on May 9.
After the boost in share capital, Tauro Bank's share capital will stand at 76 million litas.
